meta.title: AutoXpert — car parts from several vendors
meta.description: Compare and order parts that fit your vehicle, from several vendors, in one place.

home.title: Find a part that matches the vehicle you drive.
home.lead: Choose the year, make, model and engine. AutoXpert then compares offers from NAPA, Canadian Tire, PartSource and our warehouse.
home.howBody: Each product page shows the best in-stock price, then the other vendors. You order in one place; the supplier stays on the receipt.
home.trustBody: Lead times here are prototype estimates. Taxes, live freight and payment are not wired in this version.
home.vehicleNeeded: Select a vehicle to filter the catalogue.

catalog.title: Parts for your vehicle
catalog.empty: No parts in this category for the selected vehicle.
catalog.outOfStock: Out of stock at this vendor

product.ships: Ships in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
product.reviewsEmpty: Customer reviews will be wired later. This page is for comparing offers.
product.warrantyBody: Each vendor keeps its own policy. AutoXpert centralizes tracking; return windows stay those of the listed supplier.
product.advisorBody: Marc can confirm fitment before you order.
product.compat: Fitment checked for the selected vehicle.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.empty: The cart is empty. Choose a vehicle, then a part.
cart.note: Payment is not wired in this version. Totals are in Canadian dollars.

favorites.title: Saved parts
favorites.empty: No saved parts yet. Use the heart on a product page.

portal.gateBody: This version opens the portal without a password. Your vehicles, service log and cart stay in this browser.

garage.title: My vehicles
garage.lead: Keep your vehicles on file and open recommended parts.
garage.diyEmpty: DIY guides will be added in a later version.
garage.empty: No vehicles in the garage. Add one to filter the catalogue and the service log.

entretien.title: Service log
entretien.lead: Add service entries yourself. The history stays in this browser.
entretien.intervalsNote: These intervals are general references. Check the owner’s manual and how you use the car.
entretien.empty: No service recorded for this vehicle.

orders.title: My orders
orders.lead: Demo orders attached to the portal. Tracking is not connected to a carrier.

account.title: Your account
account.lead: Prototype without real authentication. The portal stores state in the browser.

footer.blurb: AutoXpert brings together several vendor catalogues for drivers in Quebec.
